Based on the provided evidence, the patient underwent an echocardiogram (implied by the detailed description of cardiac function and structure). The report states: "Funzione sistolica globale ai limiti inferiori della norma (FE stimata intorno al 45%)" which translates to global systolic function at the lower limits of normal (estimated EF around 45%). This represents a functional abnormality, specifically a decreased ejection fraction, fitting the criteria for "New focal or diffuse left or right ventricular function abnormalities".

The report also states: "con modeste alterazioni segmentarie della cinetica in sede antero-settale e apicale" which translates to modest segmental kinetic alterations (wall motion abnormalities) in the anteroseptal and apical regions. This fits the criteria for "Segmental wall motion abnormalities".

Additionally, the report notes: "lievi irregolarità dello spessore parietale in sede apicale e antero-settale" which translates to slight irregularities of the parietal thickness (wall thickness) in the apical and anteroseptal regions. This fits the criteria for "Wall thickness change".

The report explicitly states "Pericardio indenne" (Pericardium uninvolved/intact), ruling out pericardial effusion or inflammation. It also states "Ventricolo sinistro di normali dimensioni" (Left ventricle of normal dimensions), ruling out ventricular dilation. The findings are described as compatible with ischemic injury, not confirmed myocarditis via imaging criteria alone without biopsy, so options confirming myocarditis/pericarditis without details are incorrect based on the specific wording required.
